By combining financial expertise with business acumen and cross-functional collaboration, you help drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation across the region.How You’ll Make an Impact * Acting as the primary Finance Business Partner for the Compression Service Europe & Africa management team, providing financial transparency and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making* Leading regional forecasting, budgeting, financial performance reviews, and financial planning & analysis activities across a network of more than 35 countries while identifying risks and opportunities* Strengthening the Enterprise Risk Management framework and partnering with sustainability teams to support ESG initiatives, including EU Taxonomy reporting and compliance requirements* Providing financial governance and controlling support for central functions, ensuring cost transparency, effective resource allocation, and sound financial governance* Leading and supporting strategic projects and transformation initiatives, delivering financial insights, business case analyses, and value-creating recommendations* Promoting process harmonization, digitalization, and automation to improve reporting quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making capabilitiesWhat You Bring* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or other advanced degree is considered an advantage* Proven experience in controlling, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business partnering, or finance leadership within an international environment* Strong expertise in forecasting, budgeting, financial reporting, variance analysis, performance management, and financial governance, ideally complemented by knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management, ESG, or sustainability reporting* Proven analytical and strategic capabilities with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business recommendations and influence management decisions* Hands-on experience with SAP, financial planning systems, business intelligence tools, and Microsoft Office, combined with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills in multicultural organizations* Fluent English skills; additional language skills are considered an advantage About the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Analyst (d/f/m) AIRBUS (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description: As a Supply Chain Analyst (d/f/m) employed in Hamburg Fuhlsbüttel, your role will focus on ensuring seamless operations in spare parts demand planning for customer requirements in the aviation industry. In collaboration with various internal departments such as Product Management, Customer Order Desk, Procurement, Quality, Warehouse, and Logistics, you will optimize workflows, ensure inventory availability, and actively contribute to process improvement initiatives. This is a full-time role within a workforce leasing arrangement, based in the strategic hub of Hamburg Fuhlsbüttel at Airbus.Key responsibilities include:- Analyzing and validating material demand forecasts based on customer orders, planning data, and client-specific inputs.- Conducting procurement planning and ensuring the availability of inventory and materials.- Acting as a central interface between stakeholders to maintain effective communication flow.- Leveraging your expertise to support improvement and optimization projects within the supply chain processes.- Ensuring adherence to deadlines and effective coordination of operational workflows to meet organizational goals.VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:Candidates applying for this position as a Supply Chain Analyst (d/f/m) should possess essential skills, qualifications, and experiences relevant to the aviation supply chain industry. Successful individuals will display strong organizational abilities, independent operational capabilities, and exceptional communication skills.Required qualifications include:- A Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or Logistics.- Two years of professional experience in aerospace, supply chain, logistics, or data analysis/data management.- Advanced practical knowledge in SAP and familiarity with Google Workspace tools.- Proficiency in English at a negotiation level.- Self-directed and structured working style with a high degree of accountability and resilience.- Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining efficient workflow coordination.- Commitment to integrating improvement measures within a results-driven framework.Benefits:- An unlimited employment contract- 35-hour workweek- 30 days of annual leave- An annual salary of around 72.000 €- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment
